description: Land Acquisition - Haddala, Ambagamuwa D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Attaragalla, Pallegama, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purposes, including land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and compensation procedures. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
